name: Miharu
source: A teahouse poster girl living in Edo. She is actually a Shape Person that the protagonist created from kimono sash back during childhood. A gutsy person who treats the protagonist like her real sister, and unintentionally meddles in her affair despite knowing that it will do her no good.
